title: Scaled learning sample count identity
statement: For every $n,\ell\in\mathbb{N}$ and every rational learning parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq\frac12$, the learning sample count multiplied by $2^{-\ell}$ equals the number of subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$ plus $\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\delta\rceil\rceil$.
